text: A dragged dependency line in the Workflows UI sets one field: depends_on. By default it means "runs after success" — but that's only one of six real options.
Beyond the default All succeeded, a task's Run if can be At least one succeeded, None failed, All done, At least one failed, or All failed.
Fan-out is one upstream task feeding several parallel downstream tasks. Fan-in is several upstream tasks all required before one downstream task starts.
A task whose Run if condition isn't met is marked Excluded, not Failed — skipped, cascading downstream. A genuinely failed task marks dependents Upstream failed instead.
Six real conditions, two real patterns, one meaningful distinction. Next up: choosing job clusters versus all-purpose clusters for these tasks.
